Package dev.gmitch215.bytebox.html

Interface Element

All Superinterfaces:
org.teavm.jso.JSObject
public interface Element extends org.teavm.jso.JSObject
An element the rewriter has reached. Use it inside the handler call that received it.

Content is a string: text, escaped, or raw HTML with ContentOptions.html(). The platform also takes a Response or a ReadableStream; those are not wrapped here.

Since:
1.0.3
